subject.title: [MiniMax] M3 native video input support with timestamp-scaling metadata hint (reference branch only)

question: Should MiniMax M3 native video and timestamp-scaling hints land as a provider-specific path before OpenClaw has a generic raw-video content contract?
rationale: The request crosses provider API shape, raw media security policy, model-routing metadata, and session content contracts, so automation cannot choose the permanent product boundary safely.

options.title: Keep As Reference Tracker
options.body: Leave the issue open as provider-specific reference material until generic video input and security/session contracts are approved.

options.title: Approve MiniMax-First Design
options.body: Allow a MiniMax plugin implementation first, with explicit constraints for upload handling, timestamp metadata, and no hidden core fallback path.

options.title: Fold Into Generic Video Work
options.body: Close or retitle this after maintainers designate the generic direct-video issue as the sole canonical owner for provider-specific video support.

recommendation.title: Keep As Reference Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open as provider-specific reference material until generic video input and security/session contracts are approved.
